description: This file contains functions and types related to processing and managing subagent output, including extracting text, summarizing chat history, handling subagent run outcomes, and generating status lines. It also manages dependencies and provides testing utilities.

classes.name: SubagentAnnounceOutputDeps
classes.description: Type defining dependencies for subagent output functions, including callGateway and loadConfig.

classes.name: ToolResultMessage
classes.description: Type representing a message with optional role and content fields.

classes.name: SubagentOutputSnapshot
classes.description: Type representing a snapshot of subagent output, including assistant texts and tool call count.

classes.name: AgentWaitResult
classes.description: Type representing the result of waiting for a subagent run, including status, timestamps, and error message.

classes.name: SubagentRunOutcome
classes.description: Type representing the outcome of a subagent run, including status and optional error message.

methods.name: extractToolResultText
methods.description: Extracts and sanitizes text from various possible content formats of tool results.

methods.name: extractInlineTextContent
methods.description: Extracts inline text content from an array of chat content blocks.

methods.name: extractSubagentOutputText
methods.description: Extracts relevant output text from a message object based on role and content.

methods.name: countAssistantToolCalls
methods.description: Counts the number of tool or function call blocks within chat content.

methods.name: summarizeSubagentOutputHistory
methods.description: Creates a snapshot summarizing assistant fragments, silent texts, and raw texts from chat history.

methods.name: formatSubagentPartialProgress
methods.description: Formats partial progress message based on output snapshot and run outcome.

methods.name: selectSubagentOutputText
methods.description: Selects the most relevant output text from a snapshot, considering silent, assistant, partial, and raw texts.

methods.name: readSubagentOutput
methods.description: Retrieves the latest subagent output message, with fallback to latest assistant reply.

methods.name: readLatestSubagentOutputWithRetry
methods.description: Retries reading subagent output until a non-empty result is obtained or timeout occurs.

methods.name: waitForSubagentRunOutcome
methods.description: Waits for a subagent run to complete or timeout, returning the outcome.

methods.name: applySubagentWaitOutcome
methods.description: Updates and returns the outcome object based on wait result and current outcome.

methods.name: captureSubagentCompletionReply
methods.description: Captures the subagent's reply, with retries if immediate reply is empty.

methods.name: describeSubagentOutcome
methods.description: Returns a string description of a subagent run outcome.

methods.name: formatUntrustedChildResult
methods.description: Formats a string indicating untrusted child process result content.

methods.name: buildChildCompletionFindings
methods.description: Builds a formatted string of child process completion results, sorted by creation and end times.

methods.name: dedupeLatestChildCompletionRows
methods.description: Removes duplicate child completion rows, keeping only the latest per child session key.

methods.name: filterCurrentDirectChildCompletionRows
methods.description: Filters child completion rows to only include the latest run per child session key for a specific requester.

methods.name: formatDurationShort
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a short human-readable string.

methods.name: formatTokenCount
methods.description: Formats a token count into a human-readable string with suffixes.

methods.name: buildCompactAnnounceStatsLine
methods.description: Builds a status line summarizing session runtime and token usage.
